title: LED language driver: 6-state blink table (all tiers)
description: Implement the fixed LED state table from spec 19 §10. Six states only, no others: joined-idle=off, joining=0.5Hz/10%, message-waiting=0.25Hz/5%, SOS-active=2Hz/50%/continuous, hold-in-progress=4Hz/50%, fault=1Hz/50%. New patterns require amending the spec table, not inventing at the driver level. Applies to tier H primarily but also E/O LEDs. Spans spec 19 requirements 57-64.
close_reason: DONE (worker8/heft). Implemented spec/19-device-ux.md §10 LED language: fixed closed 6-state table (joined-idle off; joining 0.5Hz/10%; message-waiting 0.25Hz/5%; SOS 2Hz/50% continuous-until-cancelled per §8; hold 4Hz/50%; fault 1Hz/50%). Architecture: lichen/subsys/lichen/ux/ux_led_core.c is a pure host-testable timing engine (state -> on/off, period_ms/on_ms table, no GPIO, no Zephyr dep) so the normative table is pinned by tests independent of hardware; ux_led_zephyr.c drives led0 via lichen_hal_led_get() on a 16ms k_work tick (1/8 of the shortest 125ms on-window). Wired via new ux/ subsystem (Kconfig LICHEN_UX/LICHEN_UX_LED, rsource + add_subdirectory). VALIDATION: host tests/ux_led passes 11 conformance cases under ASan/UBSan (every period+duty measured from edges against spec-derived values, exactly-6-states, phase reset on state switch, invalid-state rejected, NULL safety, 250s wrap); ux_led_core.c + ux_led_zephyr.c compile clean for t1000_e/nrf52840 ARM; ping_l2 regression suite still passes post-merge. 3x codereview ALL DELEGATED to kimi-k3: correctness PASS (period/duty arithmetic exact, boundary edges pinned, enum/table aligned); security PASS (closed state_set validation, GPIO-ready gating, no OOB, no radio-reachable trigger); edge-cases 2 real findings FIXED: (a) no-LED path no longer burns a 16ms workqueue tick forever (start returns without scheduling when hal_led_get fails — battery floor), (b) dropped 'select LICHEN_HAS_LEDS' which would BUILD_ASSERT led0 and break LED-less boards at build time. Edge review's SOS 'continuous' ambiguity resolved against spec §8: SOS never auto-cancels and is a distinct fixed blink — periodic 2Hz/50% until explicit cancel, which the implementation satisfies. Not pushed (driver sync cadence owns push). Merge to main pulled spec 19 in first; .beads kept out of the commit per the main-only-store hook.
